annual.label: Lexus brand average yearly repair cost (RepairPal; no LC figure yet)

maint.every: Every 10,000 miles or 12 months (5,000 miles if driven hard)
maint.note: Use the full synthetic grade listed in your owner's manual; follow the maintenance reminder.
YourMechanic estimates about $600–$630 for front rotors and $330–$350 for front pads on the LC 500. Large performance rotors cost more than average.
YourMechanic estimates about $640 for rear rotors on a 2021 LC 500. The electric parking brake must be put in service mode for pad changes.
YourMechanic quotes about $746 at its shops and $900–$1,350 at dealers, which is high because of the battery type and location.

maint.every: About every 60,000–120,000 miles (check your maintenance guide)
maint.note: RepairPal estimates about $422–$536 on the LC 500 (8 plugs). The LC 500h V6 uses 6.

maint.every: First at 10 years or 100,000 miles, then every 5 years or 50,000 miles
maint.note: The LC 500h also has a separate coolant loop for its hybrid electronics.
